rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical discomfort, whether a thing causes it or a person feels it.

example.traditional: 我今日個肚有啲唔舒服。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 go3 tou5 jau5 di1 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this for feeling uneasy or ill at ease in a social situation or around particular people.

example.english: I feel uncomfortable eating with strangers all evening.
example.traditional: 同陌生人食飯，我成晚都唔自在。
example.jyutping: tung4 mak6 sang1 jan4 sik6 faan6 ngo5 sing4 maan5 dou1 m4 zi6 zoi6

rows.note: Choose this when the discomfort is specifically disgust or offense rather than general unease.

example.english: This kind of food makes me feel uncomfortable.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 zung2 sik6 mat6 hou2 faan2 gam2
